findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: incidents, hotel_rooms, start_booking, booking_status · Private data: register_agent, whoami, get_itinerary · Public sink: create_itinerary, add_stops, update_itinerary, get_itinerary, delete_itinerary, start_booking · Destructive: delete_itinerary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: incidents, hotel_rooms, start_booking, booking_status · Private data: register_agent, whoami, get_itinerary · Public sink: create_itinerary, add_stops, update_itinerary, get_itinerary, delete_itinerary, start_booking · Destructive: delete_itinerary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
